observations.summary: Jose’s Closet (AZAFAP oversight since 2025) serves foster, kinship, adoptive families and extended foster-care youth. Official searched text gives 6515 E Main St Suite 120 Mesa 85205, 480-309-1743, info@josescloset.org; Tuesday–Saturday 11 am–3 pm. Membership covers household children up to 21. First visit: caregiver photo ID, DCS placement or guardianship records, adoption records if applicable, and biological children’s birth certificates; complete packet then renew annually. Monthly clothing shopping provides roughly one week of outfits per child, at no charge. Recipient appointment requirement not stated.
questions: Is an appointment needed for a family’s first membership visit?
Can informal kinship caregivers without guardianship or DCS paperwork join?

observations.summary: Casa de Amor offers community clothing help at 819 S MacDonald, Mesa 85210, Monday–Wednesday 9–11 am; questions route 480-464-2877. Two ministry pages corroborate clothing and site hours. Recipient documents, clothing cost and ages/sizes are not established by these pages. The daily first-come limit refers specifically to food boxes, not clothing. Do not conflate co-located pregnancy-center or church schedules with clothing hours.
questions: What should someone bring to receive clothing, and are there clothing fees or visit limits?
